name: PTB-PVDA
role: Belgian left political party (Parti du Travail de Belgique / Partij van de Arbeid van België)
notes: Bilingual federal party with major campaign for a millionaires' tax (taxe des millionnaires / miljonairstaks).

name: Peter Mertens
role: General Secretary of PVDA, Member of the Chamber of Representatives
location: Belgium > Flemish Region > Antwerpen > Antwerpen / Anvers
notes: Author of Op mensenmaat (2009) and De Miljonairstaks (2015), principal architect of PVDA wealth tax proposal.

name: Raoul Hedebouw
role: President of PTB-PVDA, Member of the Chamber of Representatives
notes: Federal party president and lead parliamentary champion of the millionaires' tax.

name: Sofie Merckx
role: Group Leader of PTB-PVDA in the Chamber of Representatives
notes: General practitioner and parliamentary group leader repeatedly tabling millionaires' tax bills.

name: Parti Socialiste
notes: Co-initiator of the European Citizens' Initiative 'Tax the Rich' for a European wealth tax.

name: Paul Magnette
role: President of the Parti Socialiste, Mayor of Charleroi
notes: Co-initiator of the European Citizens' Initiative for a European wealth tax on billionaires and ultra-rich.

name: Groen
notes: Manifesto includes a progressive millionaires' tax (0.4% to 1.2% above €2.5m).

name: Nadia Naji
role: Co-Chair of Groen, Member of the Brussels Parliament
notes: Co-chair presenting the party's progressive net wealth tax proposal.

name: Jeremie Vaneeckhout
role: Co-Chair of Groen, Member of the Flemish Parliament
notes: Co-chair presenting the party's progressive net wealth tax proposal.

name: Vooruit
notes: Official petition for a 0.3% millionaires' tax on net wealth over €1m (family home exempt).

name: Conner Rousseau
role: President of Vooruit, Member of the Flemish Parliament
notes: Champion of the party's millionaires' contribution in federal coalition negotiations.

name: ABVV
role: Socialist trade union confederation (Algemeen Belgisch Vakverbond / Fédération Générale du Travail de Belgique)
notes: Major union confederation actively campaigning for wealth taxation and tax justice.

name: Thierry Bodson
role: Federal President of FGTB (Fédération Générale du Travail de Belgique)
notes: Union leader calling for a permanent wealth tax on millionaires to raise €10bn.

name: Paul De Grauwe
role: Professor at the London School of Economics, Emeritus Professor of Economics at KU Leuven
location: Belgium > Flemish Region > Vlaams-Brabant > Galmaarden / Gammerages
notes: Prominent Belgian economist repeatedly advocating progressive net wealth taxation with exemption for the first €1m.

name: Bruno Fierens
role: Shareholder in Ackermans & van Haaren family, member of Millionaires for Humanity
location: Belgium > Flemish Region > Antwerpen > Antwerpen / Anvers
notes: Fifth-generation shareholder in Ackermans & van Haaren, Belgian member of Millionaires for Humanity publicly advocating a progressive wealth tax.
